items.text: 屁脑子。什么都得我一句句给你掰开了说。
items.q: Hooman calls Eskandar dim-witted. Does '屁脑子' sound like a natural crude insult?
before: ——是啊，这消息在大学里都传开了。

items.text: 当然，你本来就是鸡巴脑子，现在更鸡巴脑子了。
items.q: Hooman mocks Eskandar as stupid with a crude made-up word. Does '鸡巴脑子' sound like natural dorm talk?
before: – 你突然卡在这个问题上了。有几种可能。要么你脑袋磕到哪里去了。要么你是鸡巴脑......

items.q: Maman, a mother from a small town, scolds her son through clenched teeth. Does this sound like her?

items.text: 其实我也没说不许坠入爱河。
items.q: Maman, a mother from a small town, lectures her son about love. Does '坠入爱河' sound like her way of talking?
before: 午后，玛曼和奥米德坐在敞开着的院门前——玛曼至今仍这样说——好让春风吹进家里，带来新鲜气息。他们喝着茶，玛曼对奥米德说：

items.text: 谁想要他就拿去，给自己留着。我们还能多给点儿。
items.q: Maman jokes bitterly that any woman can have her husband, and she would even pay extra. Does this sound like her?
before: – 我是说他也没有追着别的女人跑。

items.q: Eskandar gives up an argument with a crude shrug. Does this sound like how a young man would say it?
before: 就这样一来一回地重复着，每来回一次，重复就快上几分。直到埃斯坎达尔说：

items.text: 没有任何名字适合你，该死的。
items.q: A roommate insults another, half joking. Does '该死的' at the end sound like natural swearing?

items.text: 我们又会回到那该死的不连续上。
items.q: A roommate swears while chasing a pompous theory about physics. Does '该死的' sound natural here?
before: ——因为就算我们从量子物理的视角来看这个问题......

items.text: 太逗了。我笑得都缓过来了。
items.q: Niloofar says Eskandar's story was so funny that laughing cheered her up. Does this sound natural?

items.text: 这世界这些操蛋的运转方式。
items.q: Hooman curses the way the world works. Does this sound like natural spoken Chinese?

items.text: 那当初干嘛把屁股都拼烂了去考托福？
items.q: Hooman says Amir slaved away for an English test. Does '把屁股都拼烂了' sound natural?
before: ——再说了，你既然不是那种会申请、会出国的人，

items.text: 要是卡米亚尔当初别耍那小子气、留在宿舍，就不会空出床来，叫这两个活宝落到咱们头上了。
items.q: Hooman grumbles that a former roommate acted like a spoiled brat. Does '耍那小子气' sound natural?
before: 巴赫曼站起身，把他的书放到我床底下。然后他用手朝迈萨姆示意了一下，便上了他那张床——我上铺——躺下了。埃斯坎达尔盯着从我床底下露出来的那几本书的书角看了一会儿，然后四肢着地朝巴赫曼的书爬过去。他低下头，看着巴赫曼的书。胡曼说：

items.text: 你脑子里这会儿又在嚼什么屁玩意儿？
items.q: Hooman rudely asks what nonsense Amir is thinking now. Does this sound like natural crude talk?
before: ——胡曼，你有没有遇到过这种情况：在梦里，你把一件事讲给某个人听，事后你却开始怀疑，那最初的事到底是一场噩梦，还是一段回忆？

items.text: 你这个吃鸡巴头的，怎么尽胡说八道？
items.q: Hooman insults a friend with a crude Persian-style curse. Does it sound like a real insult in Chinese?

items.text: 是啊，他们一看见咱们就夹紧屁眼，离咱们远远的
items.q: Farid crudely says the Tehran students act stiff and keep away from them. Does this sound natural?

items.text: 经过本地化那档子事，往后不管什么鸡巴落到咱们头上，我都不会奇怪了。
items.q: Hooman says that after the policy, no bad luck will surprise him. Does this crude image sound natural?
